analysis.summary: ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a strong business performance for the financial year ended December 31, 2025, despite external volatilities such as supply chain pressures and raw material price fluctuations. Revenue from operations grew by 13.27% to ₹84,780.93 lakhs, while profit before tax stood at ₹19,853.66 lakhs. During the year, the company advanced its strategic priorities by setting up a new manufacturing facility in Gujarat, integrating Von Roll resin operations, and implementing SAP S/4HANA. The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share for the year 2025. ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a 10.09% increase in revenue from operations to ₹74,851.31 lakhs and a 10.74% increase in sales quantity for the financial year ended December 31, 2024.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the markets served by Elantas continue to show strong long-term potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the markets served by ELANTAS continue to show strong long-term potential.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that sectors such as electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry are closely aligned with India's industrial growth and infrastructure expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: Our materials support sectors such as electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry, areas that are closely aligned with India’s industrial growth and infrastructure expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed emerging new opportunities in areas such as data centres, BESS, and more sustainable material technologies.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing new opportunities emerging in areas such as data centres, BESS, and more sustainable material technologies.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year compared to the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: The overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year, compared the first half.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and obtaining governmental approvals.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is currently in the process of obtaining the requisite governmental approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating future-ready manufacturing expansion through greenfield development and greater automation.
capex_expansion.quote: At the same time, we are evaluating future-ready manufacturing expansion through greenfield development and greater automation in order to support the evolving needs of our customers.

capex_expansion.claim: Total R&D capital expenditure for the year ended December 31, 2023, was INR 20.32 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue grew by 13.27 percent during the year, while margins improved by nearly 19 percent compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 13.27 percent during the year, while margins improved by nearly 19 percent as compared to the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported facing unforeseen and unprecedented cost increases in specific raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company also faced unforeseen, unprecedented cost increases in specific raw materials that could have also impacted availability, and subsequently business sustainability.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing agility enabled the company to respond swiftly to the surge in demand from the CTC, scaling capabilities within three months.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing agility enabled us to respond swiftly to the surge in demand from the CTC (Continuous transposed conductor), scaling capabilities within three months to meet evolving customer requirements.

orders_capacity.claim: First Time Pass Rate reached 99.9 percent during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: First Time Pass Rate reached 99.9 percent during the year, reflecting stable execution across plants.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a sales volume level of 32,491 metric tonnes during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Despite the series of challenging extraneous factors, pressure on the rupee, your Company achieved a volume level of 32,491 mts, a 10.74% increase as compared to previous year i.e. 29,339 mts.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share for the year ended December 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹ 7.50/- per equity share of ₹ 10/- each, subject to the deduction of tax as applicable, for the year ended 31st December, 2025 (previous year ₹ 7.50/- per equity share).

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend payout, if approved by members at the ensuing AGM, will be ₹594.58 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend pay-out, if approved by the Members in the ensuing AGM, will be ₹ 594.58 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The funding for the land purchase in Bharuch was sourced from the company's internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The funding for the said purchase has been sourced from the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The year unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

management_commitments.claim: ALTANA has set a target to reduce emissions by 90 percent across Scope 1, 2, and 3 by 2050.
management_commitments.quote: ALTANA has set a target to reduce emissions by 90 percent across Scope 1, 2 and 3 by 2050, a target validated by the Science Based Targets initiative.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
